title: Independent FROZEN rev29 f0_binding chain census and pointer resolution for the three vacuum classes (F1/F2a/F2b)

motivation.withheld_condition: ASTRA_HANDOFF pass-07: G-FORM is withheld pending 'astra-life05-verify-gform-r3' non-author independence + FROZEN/per-file pin binding. The audit-r2 bindchain addenda (audit-r2-*-bindchain-worker-*) asked for exactly this chain check at rev27 pins; the schemas moved to rev13/rev29 bytes after that dispatch and no dedicated per-class f0_binding chain census at the rev29 pins exists in the reviews/ directory.
motivation.relation_to_worker_099_census: worker-099 frozen_r3_pin_census (a08327006a54) census-tests the 50 FROZEN rev29 declared files, both mirrors and the two taxonomy prefixes. This artifact is disjoint: it resolves the f0_binding chain declared INSIDE each of the three class schemas (declared_f0_sha256, consistency_evidence_sha256, contract pointers) against the live files, and tests cross-schema uniformity and refresh-rule satisfaction. It does not re-census the other 41 FROZEN files.
motivation.scope_note: Independent measurement artifact, NOT a schema review, NOT a gate verdict, NOT a node done, NOT a ledger/schema/map write. Worker-079 is not an author of any schema, taxonomy, evidence file or FROZEN.json.

fail_closed_rule: The harness reads the pin table from this preregistration. If any pinned input measures a different sha256 at scan time, the harness exits 2 and writes no report. If any pre-registered control does not behave as declared, the harness exits 3 and writes no report. A missing pinned input is a MISSING verdict (never a silent pass).

checks.rule: every pinned input measures its preregistered sha256 and byte count at the scan instant
artifacts/formulation/FROZEN.json rev29 declares each of the 9 binding-relevant files with the same sha256 and bytes measured here
canonical schema and its artifacts/formulation mirror both measure the FROZEN-declared sha256 and are byte-equal
f0_binding.class_contract_supplement exists and measures the FROZEN rev29 declared sha256 for that path
top-level class_contract_pointer resolves: path exists AND fragment classes.<class_id> exists in the parsed canonical taxonomy
top-level class_contract_supplement_pointer and f0_binding.class_contract_supplement_pointer agree on path+fragment AND the fragment class_contracts.<class_id> exists in the parsed supplement

declared_f0_sha256 equals the LIVE canonical taxonomy hash AND consistency_evidence_sha256 equals the LIVE evidence hash, i.e. the schema's own rule ('if the declared F0 artifact changes hash, this binding must be refreshed and the consistency check re-run before any gate verdict') is satisfied at the scan instant
the schema's own class_id equals the class whose contract it points to, and the contract fragment names the same class
artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json classes_compared contains the class id and consistent is true
the three schemas declare identical declared_f0_artifact, declared_f0_sha256, consistency_evidence, consistency_evidence_sha256 and supplement path

annotation only (not a pass/fail): evidence file mtime vs max f0_binding.checked_at and vs FROZEN frozen_at; a post-freeze byte-identical rewrite is recorded as SOFT-NOTE because the pin contract is sha256-based
annotation only: the canonical taxonomy disjointness entries for the three class pairs are recorded verbatim; no content judgement

controls.rule: declared_f0_sha256 vs live canonical taxonomy hash must register MATCH (a comparator that cannot produce MATCH is invalid)
in-memory flip of one hex digit in a copy of a declared hash must register MISMATCH
fragment class_contracts.NO-SUCH-CLASS in the supplement must register NOT_FOUND
a nonexistent pinned path must register MISSING without raising and must drive the report verdict to FAIL
a temp copy of research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml with one byte flipped must measure a different sha256 than the original

falsifiers: Any pinned input sha256 differing from the preregistration table voids the census.
A per-class F0-DECLARED-RESOLVES, EVIDENCE-DECLARED-RESOLVES or SUPPLEMENT-DECLARED-RESOLVES row measuring MISMATCH is a hash-bound hard failure for that class schema.
A pointer fragment declared in a schema that does not resolve in the file it names is a hash-bound hard failure for that class schema.
A declared_f0_sha256 that differs from the live research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml hash while the schema's refresh rule text is unchanged voids REFRESH-RULE-SATISFIED for that schema.
Re-running run_bindchain_079.py at the same pins must reproduce report.json byte-for-byte.
